title: Ask what makes the work urgent
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Identify the consequence — Ask what changes if completion happens later.; Reduce to the needed scope — Find the smallest result that serves the immediate purpose.; Expose the tradeoff — Name the commitment or resource that must change.; Agree and review — Confirm the response and inspect repeated urgency..
